visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a dark apron and bright purple nitrile gloves serves a wide, crispy-edged oyster omelet onto a wooden table. The omelet is extremely large and textured with visible greens and fried batter. (2) A close-up view shows metal chopsticks pulling up the crispy crust to reveal a gooey layer of melted cheese and reddish-brown instant noodles underneath. (3) The scene shifts to a large metal griddle where several oyster omelets are being cooked simultaneously. Fresh oysters are placed in oil, followed by eggs being cracked and a white starch slurry poured over everything. (4) Various toppings and sauces are added; one dish features a thick layer of melted cheese being torched, while a light-pink sweet and sour sauce is poured from a small blue bowl. (5) A different dish is shown: a large bowl of soup noodles with several large orange shrimp, clams, and a soft-boiled egg in a creamy orange broth. (6) The camera pans across the interior of a clean restaurant with wooden furniture, then transitions to an outdoor shot showing the shop's white circular sign '詠心煎' and the storefront on a street with scooters and greenery.
